card.name: Hedging verbs after "to" (help, reduce risk)
card.fires_on: The word "help" right after "to" when a purpose is stated, as in "to help reduce". It also fires on "risk" in "to reduce the risk of".

modes.label: to help
modes.description: "help" after "to" in a purpose clause about supplements or inhaler rinsing.
modes.example: rinse the mouth with water without swallowing to<< help>> reduce the risk of oropharynge

modes.label: reduce the risk
modes.example: Use DESCOVY to reduce the<< risk>> of acquiring HIV-1 only in individuals

card.writes: The promoted words (potentially, hopefully, may, attempt) suggest it adds hedged, softened claims about what comes next.
card.plain: It marks the phrase where a label says something is meant to "help" or "reduce the risk" rather than promising an outcome.
